job.descriptionHtml:
✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

  • Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies

  • Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 by Newsweek

  • A G2 Spring 2026 Leader across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

  • The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

Location: While this position is posted in a specific region, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote, and you can work from home. Forever. Global candidate-location options available.

In this highly strategic and cross-functional role, you’ll own and evolve Oyster’s global network of external payroll partners and core compliance providers that underpins end-to-end payroll delivery across our markets. Operating with a primary focus (~80%) on core multi-country payroll delivery, vendor accuracy, calendar adherence, and operational controls, alongside secondary oversight (~20%) of specialized Compliance vendors, you’ll ensure our partners deliver scalable, high-quality, and fully compliant solutions that enable our customers to hire anyone, anywhere. You’ll combine commercial acumen, operational excellence, regulatory monitoring, and strong relationship management to drive vendor performance, execute risk assessments, resolve complex payroll escalations, and continuously strengthen our global partner ecosystem. From leading commercial negotiations, compliance tracking, and governance frameworks to identifying new partner opportunities and ensuring alignment with local legal and statutory payroll standards, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how Oyster delivers global employment solutions at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and can confidently influence stakeholders internally and externally. You are commercially minded, data-driven, solutions-oriented, and energized by building strong partnerships that create long-term business impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert and primary operational and commercial owner for Oyster's strategic multi-country payroll partners worldwide.

  • Maintain deep operational mastery of end-to-end payroll delivery workflows, cut-off calendars, variance analysis, Gross-to-Net (GTN) calculations, statutory filings, and failure modes across key markets

  • Partner with internal Pay & Payroll operations teams to monitor partner SLA compliance, data payload delivery, and payroll cut-off adherence

  • Proactively evaluate vendor capacity, operational readiness, and processing controls ahead of peak payroll cycles and expansion into new markets

  • Define partner strategy, governance, scorecards, review cadences, escalation thresholds, and improvement plans

  • Hold partners accountable for payroll accuracy, timeliness, statutory compliance, compliance tracking, responsiveness, controls, and customer outcomes

  • Manage the full vendor relationship lifecycle, from partner selection and onboarding through transition, consolidation, or exit decisions

  • Evaluate partner capabilities, market coverage, operational maturity, security/compliance posture, and scalability

  • Build and maintain expertise in multi-country payroll delivery, regulatory dependencies, and contractual trade-offs

Vendor Performance & Governance

  • Establish baselines and monitor vendor performance through KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, and remediation plans

  • Lead recurring executive business reviews and performance discussions with partner leadership teams

  • Translate payroll-partner performance data into recommendations for Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Customer teams, and leadership

  • Monitor operational performance and proactively identify service risks or quality concerns

  • Conduct structured vendor compliance audits, risk assessments, and operational reviews across the partner ecosystem

  • Drive consistent governance standards, regulatory alignment, and operational excellence across vendors

  • Lead ongoing regulatory monitoring, risk assessments, and compliance tracking to ensure there are no gaps in compliance across all payroll and compliance vendor operations and local legal standards across all operating regions

Commercial & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted, long-term relationships with external partner leadership teams

  • Lead or materially shape commercial negotiations, contract renewals, pricing, remedies, and service changes

  • Strengthen strategic partnerships to support business growth and customer outcomes

  • Lead complex, multi-market payroll escalations through root-cause analysis, recovery, prevention, and executive communication

  • Collaborate cross-functionally and externally to resolve sensitive operational challenges

  • Support customer and internal stakeholder conversations requiring partner expertise

  • Identify and source new partners to strengthen global coverage and capabilities

Vendor Ecosystem Development

  • Identify operational or geographic gaps within the vendor ecosystem

  • Evaluate and onboard new partners to strengthen Oyster’s global coverage

  • Recommend improvements to ecosystem strategy, scalability, and service quality

  • Partner cross-functionally to evolve how Oyster leverages and manages external vendors

  • Drive initiatives that improve partner consistency, efficiency, and customer experience

Strategic Business Partnership

  • Advise internal teams on vendor capabilities, strengths, and operational considerations

  • Guide partner selection decisions based on customer needs and business priorities

  • Share insights from vendor trends, escalations, and operational performance data

  • Partner with Go-To-Market teams to support deal strategy and customer solutions

  • Enable scalable and commercially sound global employment solutions

  • Proactively partner with internal teams including HRBPs, Employee Lifecycle Teams, and Payroll/Pay teams to align vendor capabilities with employee support and operational workflows

Escalation Leadership

  • Maintain secondary oversight (~20%) of specialized Health & Safety and Compliance vendor relationships, ensuring partner capabilities and SLAs support local statutory requirements

  • Lead high-impact escalations across external partners and internal teams with limited direction

  • Coordinate cross-functional and cross-partner responses to critical operational issues

  • Protect customer experience while balancing operational and commercial priorities

  • Identify root causes and recurring trends across escalations

  • Drive preventative improvements and operational maturity across the partner ecosystem

  • Lead in escalations on calls to get to root cause, find solutions, and manage end-to-end resolution.

Continuous Improvement & High Performance

  • Continuously audit and refine workflows and ways of working to reduce response times and elevate service quality.

  • Build scalable processes, knowledge, automation, and AI-enabled reporting while protecting payroll and personal data.

  • Analyze recurring ticket trends and received queries to identify systemic issues, proactively building preventative resources for internal teams.

  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and knowledge management, ensuring Pearls have accurate, accessible self-service resources to reduce dependency and improve operational efficiency.

Projects

  • Lead People Services and cross-functional projects as we work towards our Mission to enable companies to hire anyone, anywhere!

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years of direct experience managing multi-country Payroll Vendors and Compliance/Health & Safety partners in a global environment

  • Strong technical understanding of end-to-end payroll processing cycles, Gross-to-Net (GTN) calculations, statutory filings, and payroll controls

  • Significant experience owning strategic payroll and compliance vendor relationships in a global or multi-country environment

  • Deep understanding of payroll operations, compliance tracking, risk assessments, statutory controls, regulatory monitoring, and global legal standards

  • Evidence of improving vendor performance and regulatory alignment through KPIs, SLAs, vendor compliance audits, governance, remediation, and executive business reviews

  • Commercial negotiation and contract-management capability, including pricing, service levels, remedies, renewals, and trade-offs

  • Highly strategic thinker with the ability to balance operational detail with long-term business goals

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to drive decisions and improvements

  • Commercially minded and solutions-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to operational challenges

  • Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills across internal and external stakeholders

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience managing complex escalations and driving resolution across multiple stakeholders

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal

  • Collaborative and cross-functional by nature, with experience partnering across Operations, Legal, Support, Sales, and Customer-facing teams

  • Process-oriented and continuously looking for ways to improve scalability and operational maturity

  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping shape evolving operational functions and frameworks

  • Demonstrated track record of proactive business partnering with internal stakeholders such as HRBPs, Lifecycle Teams, and Pay teams

  • [BONUS] Experience working with global vendors across multiple regions (APAC, EMEA, LATAM, AMER)

  • [BONUS] Experience building or scaling vendor governance programs and operational frameworks

  • [BONUS] Additional languages

  • [BONUS] Have worked in a fast-paced, scaling startup or global tech environment

  • [BONUS] Experience implementing AI tools or automation workflows to improve workflows and vendor management

You'll also need

  • A reliable home internet connection (or be able to get one)

  • Fluent English language

How we work together at Oyster

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ so other global teams can learn from us.

How YOU work

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

  • Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

  • Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

  • Mental health support: Access Plumm, our mental well-being service.

  • Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

  • Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

  • WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone 

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline.

*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.
Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.
These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.
In the first month, expect to:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.
In the first three months, expect to:
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

It is ideal for individuals who have successfully sold enterprise AI solutions and are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives.
Enterprise AI has shifted rapidly from experimentation to execution. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes.
The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production.
Toptal brings together world-class AI and domain talent, forward-deployed solution delivery, AI platforms and capabilities, strategic technology partners, expert-in-the-loop operations, and managed services to help enterprises move from AI promise to production.
This role exists to convert that market opportunity into new enterprise relationships and position Toptal as a strategic partner for companies deploying AI across their organizations.
This is a remote position with significant client-facing fieldwork across the US. Applicants who reside within commutable distance of a major metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
*The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.
Net new accounts may begin with a specific AI initiative, workflow, platform implementation, or business problem requiring a disciplined approach to defining the opportunity and matching the right Toptal capabilities to the client’s needs. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships.
These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal.
Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.
In the first month, expect to:
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Toptal AI Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, solution portfolio, partner ecosystem, and client engagement model.
Work with AI Services leadership to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Shadow key calls and client meetings.
Begin to meet with clients, leveraging your existing enterprise AI network and relationships, to articulate Toptal’s capabilities and identify where we can help organizations move AI into production.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with SDRs, Client Partners, and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pursuits and Delivery teams to understand how we design AI engagements.
In the first three months, expect to:
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage with Toptal’s AI capabilities and specialists.
Begin shaping AI solutions that resonate with your target accounts, including forward-deployed AI solutions, Outcome Agents, agentic workflows, enterprise data and knowledge solutions, AI platforms, and managed AI services, demonstrating your comfort and ability in working with ambiguity and directly innovating alongside your clients.
Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their AI priorities, business workflows, existing technology investments, and desired outcomes.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.
Develop proposals and close your first set of deals.
Actively contribute to team rituals, best practice sharing, and win/loss reviews.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Expand your buyer network and deepen executive engagement across your accounts.
Drive net new opportunities by introducing additional AI capabilities, platforms, solutions, partners, and managed services and displacing incumbent providers.
Shape and influence client priorities, aligning Toptal’s AI solutions to critical business objectives and measurable, validated outcomes.
Execute against a defined growth plan tied to measurable outcomes.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize Toptal’s AI capabilities to address their priorities and key business challenges.
Establish and expand a strong executive network across your portfolio, building a foundation of advocates and sponsors.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our AI model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Be recognized for your subject matter expertise in enterprise AI solutions, leveraging your existing network and relationships as well as your proven consultative selling skills to drive meaningful results for your clients and the overall AI Services team.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
7-10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, AI software, professional services, or consulting sales, with a strong foundation in enterprise account development and complex solution selling.
Direct experience selling enterprise AI solutions is required, ideally including forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software or platforms, AI consulting and professional services, or managed AI services.
Extensive experience in consultative customer engagement and selling service-oriented, technology-enabled, or outcome-based solutions to enterprise clients.
Demonstrated success building a book of business from the ground up, i.e. self-sourcing, prospecting, and developing new enterprise relationships rather than relying on an inherited portfolio.
Proven track record managing a $5M+ annualized gross portfolio and closing $250K-$1M+ complex, multi-phase deals with enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
Must be comfortable engaging C-level executives on how AI is changing their business, technology environment, operating model, workforce, and competitive landscape.
A well-rounded understanding of enterprise AI challenges and trends, including generative AI, agentic AI, AI applications and platforms, enterprise data and knowledge, models, workflow automation, governance, evaluation, controls, and managed AI operations.
Ability to have informed discussions about how AI moves from strategy and experimentation into real enterprise workflows and production environments, including the importance of context, data, integration, validation, governance, adoption, and ongoing operations.
Experience selling solutions involving leading AI, cloud, data, or enterprise technology platforms, and the ability to work in a platform-flexible environment across client technology ecosystems.
Exposure to hybrid talent models, forward-deployed delivery models, or alternative consulting delivery models.
Ability to build and execute account plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in collaborative prospecting, running virtual and on-site sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Ability to partner effectively across multiple internal teams to shape innovative solutions that drive client success.
Willingness and ability to travel to client sites, conferences, and team events (up to 25%).
Passion for solving client problems with creativity and urgency.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

job.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

This role is 100% remote and open to US-based candidates at this time.

Your Impact

Help Scout is at a pivotal moment. We've laid the foundation of a strong, customer-loved product with a distinct brand and a mission-driven team. Now we're becoming an AI-driven organization with a new strategic narrative, a redefined ICP, and a go-to-market motion built to match. Our 2026 strategy is focused, ambitious, and rooted in clear outcomes, from pipeline and trials to customer expansion.

As VP of People, you'll step into a company with a strong remote-first culture ready to scale its reach and influence. You'll shape how we grow and differentiate ourselves as an employer of choice and bring our values to life at every stage of the team member journey.

This is a great opportunity to lead the people function at a company that believes in craft, autonomy, and building things that matter. You will help determine which of our People practices are scalable as they exist, and which need to change in order to scale effectively.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a remote-first company. You should expect high accountability, meaningful autonomy, and the opportunity to build, test, and refine how people drive growth at Help Scout.

About the role

  • You'll lead a team that owns all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding to people and organizational development, as well as all programs including global compensation, organizational design, performance management, and employee retention and engagement.

  • You'll ensure we have a robust and scalable culture. Being a remote-first company comes with unique opportunities and challenges. You and your team lead the charge in maintaining a strong values-driven and accountable culture. You'll also own the systems that support remote work and collaboration.

  • You'll define how we measure the health of our people and our People programs, maintain that health, and regularly share progress at the leadership level and across the business. You'll use data to guide decisions, challenge assumptions, and adjust strategy when the signal changes.

  • You'll build our talent strategy and execute against it to ensure all our people programs and practices are aligned and effective, including a robust recruiting strategy and partnership to support hiring managers through the process.

  • You'll bring an AI lens to everything, including how the People team uses AI to move faster and sharpen how they work, and helping all team members better leverage AI to work more effectively.

  • You'll drive Help Scout's new strategic narrative forward through our people. Our business is nothing without our people. You’ll align our People programs to our business needs in a seamless and integrated way.

  • You'll establish clear planning, prioritization, and execution rhythms that provide clarity to your teams so they can operate at their best.

About You

  • You've served as a people leader at a scaling B2B SaaS company in the $30M–$150M ARR range.

  • You've led organizations through a growth stage and you know what it takes to get people thinking differently about how to get work done in a changing environment.

  • You've had hands-on experience as an HRBP in your career. You deeply understand what it means to be a partner to the business.

  • You have a genuine point of view on how AI can advance organizations’ people practices – not just as a set of tools, but as a shift in how individuals and teams operate. You're excited to put that into practice.

  • You are creative in thinking about people and people strategies. You leveraging innovative approaches in leadership to ensure people can perform at their best and have a great experience.

  • You hold a high bar, elevate those around you, and communicate clearly and empathetically in a remote setting.

  • You like to ship, measure, adjust. You aren't afraid of the tension between performance goals and long-term vision.

Who you’ll work with

  • Shawna Fisher – you’ll report to Shawna, our COO

  • Toby Gabriner – our CEO

  • Great people team members like Heidi, Julie, and Allison

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.

job.descriptionPlain:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
Toptal’s inbound sales team is a driving force behind our growth, converting inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. As Manager, SMB Sales, you will lead a team of Client Advisors, coaching them towards growth and holding them to a high standard of excellence in a high-velocity, consultative selling role. You will keep the team responsive to new inquiries while ensuring active opportunities continue to move. You will coach advisors through stalled decisions, specialist involvement, and client follow-up, stepping in where your judgement can help secure the next commitment. You will lead a team that is responsible for executing strong discovery, disciplined qualification, portfolio selling across Toptal’s full offering with complete ownership of the client relationship from first conversation through close. Your team’s job is to position Toptal as a strategic services partner, not a single-transaction talent vendor, and you set that standard.
You will be accountable for improving conversion of inbound leads by identifying conversion leakage, bringing accountability to individuals’ performance, hiring Client Advisors with consultative potential, reviewing calls, demonstrating stronger approaches, and coaching each advisor on changes to improve their sales skill and industry knowledge. Internally, this position works closely with leadership across Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People to support a team-based approach to best-in-class service.
Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by team success, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about what makes a sales team excellent. If you want to sharpen a team’s performance and be recognized for the results, this is the team you want to be part of.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.
Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.
Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.
Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.
Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.
Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.
Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.
Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..
Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.
Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.
Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.
Culture: Drive a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team — including a learn-it-all habit of self and peer call review, and a library of strong calls that show the standard.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal leadership.
Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
Become acquainted with the team members who will report to you.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete Toptal’s leadership/sales training program and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and how Client Advisors sell across our full portfolio.
Understand your team and their current performance levels, the SMB Sales Leadership and expectations, and identify the main causes of conversion leakage.
Begin 1-1 coaching with each team member based on ongoing live and recorded call reviews.
In the first three months, expect to:
Develop and roll out your strategy to increase team performance and productivity, with individual goals set for each team member.
Run consistent coaching and opportunity-review cadences with specific improvement priorities for each Client Advisor.
Deliver your first cross-departmental presentation covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans.
In the first six months, expect to:
Demonstrate measurable commercial improvement in conversion and sales performance from Client Advisors being coached, supported by stronger call quality scores, opportunity progression, and qualified HireGlobal and services opportunities.
Regularly assess performance against KPIs, partnering with sales enablement and operations to continuously improve.
Continue building, coaching, and mentoring your team toward greater results.
In the first year, expect to:
Run an optimized, well-managed inbound sales function that maximizes Toptal’s ability to capture SMB market demand profitably.
Develop senior Client Advisors who mentor new team members and serve as reference points on discovery quality and portfolio positioning.
Sustain a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and record-breaking results and client experiences.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree required.
Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.
Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.
Experience managing pipeline and forecast rigor across a team in a CRM. Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI in the world of work, including using AI to improve how a sales team researches, reviews calls, and coaches.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategy to cross-departmental partners.
Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities.
Full availability during working hours to support your team and step into client escalations as needed.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading a team that sells more than one product or service line into the same account (portfolio selling).
Experience with a named sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar).
Software, tech, or professional-services sales leadership experience.
Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted call review, conversation intelligence, and CRM workflows.
Core Competencies
These are the skills we evaluate during interviews and continue to develop with you after you join.
Consultative sales mastery. You can run and model an excellent discovery call yourself — open-ended discovery, disciplined qualification, and a dated, named next step — and show your team what good looks like.
Coach-first leadership. You develop people through call review, role-play, and specific feedback, not just dashboards. Your team gets better because you are in the details with them.
Talent judgment. You can spot curiosity, business acumen, and coachability in an interview, and you can tell real potential from polish.
Insight-led selling. You can teach Client Advisors to bring a point of view, reframe a client’s thinking when needed, and position Toptal as a strategic services partner rather than a talent marketplace.
Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.
Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.
Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.
job.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal’s inbound sales team is a driving force behind our growth, converting inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. As Manager, SMB Sales, you will lead a team of Client Advisors, coaching them towards growth and holding them to a high standard of excellence in a high-velocity, consultative selling role. You will keep the team responsive to new inquiries while ensuring active opportunities continue to move. You will coach advisors through stalled decisions, specialist involvement, and client follow-up, stepping in where your judgement can help secure the next commitment. You will lead a team that is responsible for executing strong discovery, disciplined qualification, portfolio selling across Toptal’s full offering with complete ownership of the client relationship from first conversation through close. Your team’s job is to position Toptal as a strategic services partner, not a single-transaction talent vendor, and you set that standard.

You will be accountable for improving conversion of inbound leads by identifying conversion leakage, bringing accountability to individuals’ performance, hiring Client Advisors with consultative potential, reviewing calls, demonstrating stronger approaches, and coaching each advisor on changes to improve their sales skill and industry knowledge. Internally, this position works closely with leadership across Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People to support a team-based approach to best-in-class service.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by team success, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about what makes a sales team excellent. If you want to sharpen a team’s performance and be recognized for the results, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Coach: Coach Client Advisors on discovery, qualification, portfolio selling, and deal management. Demonstrate how to bring a useful point of view, support recommendations with relevant proof points, address concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Develop: Review live and recorded calls, examine active opportunities, and identify specific changes that will improve each Client Advisor’s results. Run focused role-plays, demonstrate stronger approaches, and give clear, actionable feedback.
  • Hire and Build: Recruit and interview Client Advisors against our Client Advisor Core Competencies, hiring for consultative potential - curiosity, business acumen, and coachability - as well as sales experience.
  • Playbook Ownership: Own and continuously refine the Client Advisor inbound playbook, using call audit findings and conversion data to keep it current and effective.
  • Manage Performance: Understand causes of underperformance and agree specific corrective actions and timelines with Client Advisors. Demonstrate sustained improvement in team conversion and sales performance, supported by stronger discovery, qualification, follow-through, and portfolio expansion.
  • Onboard and Ramp: Manage onboarding for new Client Advisors, ensuring they complete sales training and assessing each new advisor against the skill-based Client Advisor ramp milestones — running discovery unaided, qualifying a live opportunity, surfacing needs beyond the initial request — on the path to independent, quota-carrying performance.
  • Career Development: Support career development and succession planning for Client Advisors, including the path into leadership.
  • Pipeline Oversight: Challenge the evidence behind each Client Advisor’s view of an opportunity: why it may proceed, what remains unresolved, when decisions are likely, and use that judgment to improve qualification and prioritize support, and strengthen forecasting discipline..
  • Operational Excellence: Identify process improvements that increase Client Advisor efficiency, productivity, and scalability.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly with cross-functional partners that include, but are not limited to: Client Services, Talent Operations, Client Experience, and People leadership. Additionally, be able to bring in the right specialists (matching, delivery, HireGlobal, service-offering experts) at the right time.
  • Reporting: Deliver presentations to cross-departmental partners covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans based on data analysis.
  • Motivation and Recognition: Motivate the team through recognition, incentives, and transparent communication of expectations and results.
  • Culture: Drive a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the team — including a learn-it-all habit of self and peer call review, and a library of strong calls that show the standard.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal leadership.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Become acquainted with the team members who will report to you.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete Toptal’s leadership/sales training program and build a deep understanding of who our clients are and how Client Advisors sell across our full portfolio.
  • Understand your team and their current performance levels, the SMB Sales Leadership and expectations, and identify the main causes of conversion leakage.
  • Begin 1-1 coaching with each team member based on ongoing live and recorded call reviews.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Develop and roll out your strategy to increase team performance and productivity, with individual goals set for each team member.
  • Run consistent coaching and opportunity-review cadences with specific improvement priorities for each Client Advisor.
  • Deliver your first cross-departmental presentation covering metrics, key takeaways, and action plans.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial improvement in conversion and sales performance from Client Advisors being coached, supported by stronger call quality scores, opportunity progression, and qualified HireGlobal and services opportunities.
  • Regularly assess performance against KPIs, partnering with sales enablement and operations to continuously improve.
  • Continue building, coaching, and mentoring your team toward greater results.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an optimized, well-managed inbound sales function that maximizes Toptal’s ability to capture SMB market demand profitably.
  • Develop senior Client Advisors who mentor new team members and serve as reference points on discovery quality and portfolio positioning.
  • Sustain a culture of high performance, continuous improvement, and record-breaking results and client experiences.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Three or more years in business-to-business sales, featuring one to two years direct leadership of inbound, inside, or end-to-end small business sales teams.
  • Demonstrated record of improving individual and team sales performance through specific coaching, disciplined opportunity management, and clear performance expectations. Ability to learn and coach to a structured sales methodology.
  • Experience managing pipeline and forecast rigor across a team in a CRM. Genuine, demonstrable passion for AI in the world of work, including using AI to improve how a sales team researches, reviews calls, and coaches.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting metrics and strategy to cross-departmental partners.
  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic environment with evolving processes and priorities.
  • Full availability during working hours to support your team and step into client escalations as needed.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a team that sells more than one product or service line into the same account (portfolio selling).
  • Experience with a named sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar).
  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales leadership experience.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted call review, conversation intelligence, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

These are the skills we evaluate during interviews and continue to develop with you after you join.

  • Consultative sales mastery. You can run and model an excellent discovery call yourself — open-ended discovery, disciplined qualification, and a dated, named next step — and show your team what good looks like.
  • Coach-first leadership. You develop people through call review, role-play, and specific feedback, not just dashboards. Your team gets better because you are in the details with them.
  • Talent judgment. You can spot curiosity, business acumen, and coachability in an interview, and you can tell real potential from polish.
  • Insight-led selling. You can teach Client Advisors to bring a point of view, reframe a client’s thinking when needed, and position Toptal as a strategic services partner rather than a talent marketplace.
  • Accountable. You take ownership of your team’s results and hold your team accountable to raising their own bar.
  • Critical thinker. Strong analytical and problem-resolution skills, with a demonstrated ability to develop data-driven solutions.
  • Proactive, collaborative communicator. You drive toward the mission without being told, and you communicate clearly across your team, cross-functional partners, and clients essential in our remote environment.

job.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer - GTM
job.descriptionHtml:
✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

  • Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies

  • Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 by Newsweek

  • A G2 Spring 2026 Leader across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

  • The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

Location: Fully remote. To create the best experience for you and to meet our business needs, this role requires you to be based within the EMEA or AMER regions.

You’ll join Oyster as a Senior AI Solutions Engineer: Go-to-Market, reporting to the AI Director and partnering closely with GTM leadership.

Your mandate goes beyond automating individual tasks. You’ll help make Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations AI native. This means rethinking how people work with AI, where agents can take on operational work, and where human judgement creates the most value to build a more effective AI enabled GTM organization.

You’ll be part of a connected group of Senior AI Solutions Engineers transforming different departments across Oyster. Together, you’ll establish shared standards, reuse successful approaches, and ensure Oyster’s AI transformation is coordinated rather than siloed.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As an Enterprise Sales Executive on our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) team, you will build a portfolio of clients by prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing new accounts. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, and management consulting. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a territory from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts from scratch - identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Working closely with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities while also expanding existing relationships.
You’ll operate in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment, working alongside pre-sales experts and delivery teams to craft compelling, tailored solutions for each client.
Your initial portfolio will scale toward an annualized gross sales target of $1M in your first year, with expectations to grow into a $5M book by years 2–3, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.
We are seeking scrappy, bold, client-obsessed professionals who are energized by face-to-face interaction, inspired by client success, and motivated to close high-impact deals. This is not a “work from your home office” role. We’re looking for professionals who are ready to get in the field, build lasting relationships, and lead with purpose.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard with Toptal, learning the core of our model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities.
Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful.
Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.
Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes.
In the first month, expect to:
Work with your Portfolio Leader to establish a portfolio strategy and build account plans.
Begin to meet with clients, articulate Toptal’s capabilities, and identify where we can help organizations in your territory plan.
Meet key Toptal stakeholders who will support your success and the success of the overall team.
Learn about the Industry Go-To-Market Strategy, our key sales plays, and our client engagement model.
Begin prospecting and actively engaging target accounts within your portfolio.
Meet with Sales Development Representatives and Client Partners and cross-functional team members to align on joint account strategies.
Collaborate with Pre-Sales Solutions and Delivery teams to understand how we design engagements.
In the first three months, expect to:
Conduct research and outreach through multiple channels to uncover new business opportunities within your accounts and drive sales pursuits with cross-functional Toptal teams.
Exercise discretion and independent judgment in the negotiation of contracts, work collaboratively with clients, and help them engage Toptal’s engineering, design, and business specialists.
Provide consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.
Provide advice and support for the planning of long term or short term business objectives or initiatives.
In the first six months, expect to:
Have an initial base of active clients, while continuing to build your overall portfolio.
Develop a network of client relationships and build a foundation of advocates and sponsors to expand Toptal’s partnership with existing accounts in alignment with your portfolio strategy.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a list of incredible client accounts, advising them on how to utilize our talent network to build world-class distributed teams and increase efficiency.
Begin to mentor new members of the team, teaching them about Toptal, our model, and how to successfully grow their territory.
Continue to expand your portfolio of accounts, accelerate growth in your region, and use the full suite of capabilities that Toptal has to offer.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
Extensive experience in engaging and selling Consulting or Managed Services solutions, particularly within Financial Services or Professional Services organizations.
Proven track record in full-cycle sales of large, complex, multi-phase, managed technology projects to enterprise clients with $2B+ in annual revenue.
A well-rounded understanding of emerging technologies and ability to have an informed discussion about software delivery and development concepts with prospective clients.
Ability to build and execute territory plans that lead to consistent portfolio growth and a healthy pipeline.
Proven success in prospecting, running virtual sales calls, and leading sales pursuits backed by a multidisciplinary team.
Experience negotiating complex service agreements with procurement and legal departments within enterprise accounts.
Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location (25% or less).
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on sales development results. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.
