You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

Role Overview

ConvaTec is building a data function and data governance is central to that build. This is a critical delivery role within it. This role will contribute to making Convatec’s data findable, traceable and trustworthy.

Working with the business the Data Governance Analyst will support core elements of our data governance capability – the business glossary and data catalogue in Microsoft Purview, data lineage and a data quality framework that moves us from finding problems in reports to preventing them at source.

Our governance capability is being stood up from the ground up so the candidate will be comfortable establishing new processes and artefacts and equally comfortable with business stakeholders to get them adobted with the support of data leadership.

About Role

1. Data Cataloguing and Metadata Management

  • Build, populate and maintain the enterprise business glossary and data catalogue in Microsoft Purview (for example Finance & FP&A, Commerial, CRM, Supply Chain).

  • Adminstor the tooling so catalogue does not decay after go-live.

  • Engage data owners, stewards and subject matter experts to agree and publish common definitions for critical data elements, resolving conflicting versions to a single agreed source, and enforcing the metadata standards that make catalogue entries genuinely usable.

2. Data Lineage

  • Capture and maintain end-to-end lineage for critical data elements across the full pipeline and documented in a form both engineers and business stakeholders can act on.

  • Estalish change impact analysis so that upstream source change identifies and warns the affected downstream reports, models and consumers in advance.

3. Data Quality

  • Work with business data owners and governance sponsors to translate business risk into testable data quality rules across the recognised dimensions, and implement them as automated, monitored checks with dashboards, agreed thresholds and a defined exception route.

  • Profile data, lead root cause analysis on quality issues through to conclusion with measurable outcomes and manage data quality issues log end to end.

  • Support the shift from reactive reconciliation to preventative controls applied at the point of capture or ingestion.

4. Governance Framework, Stewardship and Adoption

  • Support the implementation of the data governance framework, policies and standards, producing clear, user-friendly documentation and guidance that the business will use.

  • Help embed the ownership and stewardship model.

  • Contribute to governance KPIs and KRIs.

About You

  • Proven experience (typically 3+ years) in Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Management or a closely adjacent role in a large or complex organization.

  • Demonstratable hands-on experience of at least two of: Business Glossary, Data Catalogue, Data lineage or Data Quality

  • Experience with Microsoft Purview is desirable

  • Practical experience implementing or configuring a data governance or cataloguing tool.

  • Proven ability to bridge business and technology.

Desirable

  • Experience working in S4/Hana or SAP environment

  • Experience in a regulated industry

  • Experience with dedicated data quality or observability tooling

  • Exposure to master and reference data management

Education/ Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering), or equivalent practical experience

We are changing how existing and future domain names are owned, traded, and financed. Our team is stacked with operators who spent the last three decades shaping the internet, from pioneering domain monetization to architecting core internet protocols to launching and running major TLDs like .xyz, .inc, .tv, and .link. The round funds our mission to bring domains fully on-chain and open new financial rails for one of the internet's most valuable asset classes. We are globally distributed with team members across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. We are looking for driven builders to help us grow a trillion-dollar DomainFi economy. Join us.

Job Overview

We are hiring a Digital Marketing Associate to support execution across every surface where Doma and D3 show up: social, digital events, content, campaigns, and reporting. This is a generalist role on a small, fast-moving team. In one week you might edit a YouTube clip, run production for an X Space, pull campaign numbers into a weekly report, write a thread, and build a Luma page. This is a first or second job in marketing, and it moves at startup speed. If you want a repeatable checklist, this is not the role. If you want reps across the full marketing stack at an early-stage crypto infrastructure company, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities

Social Marketing

  • Support daily publishing across X, LinkedIn, and YouTube: drafting, scheduling, formatting, and posting
  • Own community listening and engagement queues, surfacing replies and mentions worth a response
  • Test and build new channels (TikTok, Farcaster, Telegram, short-form video) and report back on what works
  • Maintain the content calendar and keep contributors on deadline
  • Produce social graphics, event flyers, and slide edits from existing brand templates in Figma or Canva, Manage the asset library and keep versions organized
  • Brief and coordinate with our visual designer and outside contractors
  • Build weekly and monthly performance reports across social, web, email, and campaign channels
  • Track UTMs, tag links, and keep attribution clean
  • Keep track of reporting. Turn numbers into a point of view. Tell us what to do more of and what to kill

Digital Events

  • Run production for X Spaces, webinars, AMAs, and podcast recordings: run-of-show, speaker prep, reminders, recording, and follow-up
  • Build event pages, registration flows, and reminder sequences
  • Cut recordings into clips, quote cards, and recap posts within 48 hours of the event

Content Creation

  • Draft social copy, newsletter sections, event recaps, and blog support material
  • Repurpose long-form assets (reports, podcasts, panels) into channel-native formats
  • Keep our voice consistent for two audiences at once: domain industry veterans and crypto-native traders

Launch Campaign Support

  • Support go-to-market for protocol upgrades, partner announcements, and token launches
  • Build and maintain campaign trackers, asset checklists, and launch-day run-of-show
  • Coordinate KOL toolkits, partner co-marketing assets, and community distribution

Qualifications

  • 1-to-3 years of relevant marketing experience. Agency, startup, or in-house all count
  • Project management instincts: you track your own deadlines, you chase down blockers, and nothing falls through the cracks
  • Comfort with incomplete information. You make a call, flag the assumption, and keep moving
  • Strong sense of ownership. You treat a task as yours from brief to published, including the unglamorous parts
  • Ability to context-switch across five projects in a day without losing the thread
  • Clear, fast writing. Short sentences, no AI slop filler
  • Working fluency with the modern marketing stack: social schedulers, analytics dashboards, Figma or Canva, Notion or similar
  • Comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Nice to Haves

  • Web3 or crypto background. Ideal, not required. Curiosity and a fast learning curve matter more
  • Domain industry exposure, or a genuine interest in how the internet's naming layer works
  • Video editing chops and a feel for short-form pacing
  • Experience running live audio or webinar production
  • Basic HTML, CSS, or no-code site building (Claude Code, Webflow, Framer)
  • Data comfort: spreadsheets, dashboards, light SQL
  • Meme literacy. You know the difference between funny and cringe, and you know which accounts set the tone

Why D3, Why Now?

Ground-Floor Growth, Learning, and Impact: D3 is your chance to dive headfirst into an ultra-early-stage company where every move you make truly matters. You’ll have the opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and shape the foundation of something groundbreaking. Almost everything we’re building today at D3 is “zero-to-one,” meaning you’ll be among the first to craft, refine, and launch key initiatives that define our future success.

Strong, Proven Leadership: At D3, you’ll work alongside industry visionaries who have been there, done that, and are ready to do it again—only bigger. Our leadership team brings veteran industry experience, sharp insights, and a relentless drive to do big things across every function at D3. You’ll gain invaluable mentorship, develop a high-impact mindset, and be challenged to grow in ways you never imagined.

Unique Market Positioning – We’re pioneering at the intersection of internet infrastructure, real-world assets, and blockchain communities, creating solutions that redefine what’s possible in Web3. If you want to push boundaries, solve complex problems, and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of the Internet, D3 is the place to do it.

About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.


Summary

Our team is growing! We’re looking for an experienced Integration Solutions Associate to provide deep technical expertise to support the pre- to post-sales process with enterprise customers. You have a deep understanding of Firework’s products market fit and are the subject matter expert with technical knowledge regarding our suite of products and alignment to a variety of different verticals. You are business-savvy while technical, customer-centric, can empathize with customer challenges, and thrive on building solutions to scale.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner cross-functionally during the pre- and post-sales process to understand technical requirements and translate to scalable integration solutions and support to internal teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success) as well as with the external customers

  • Drive the onboarding process by bringing solutions discovery, technical enablement, product deployment assessment, and platform integration expertise

  • Assess customers requirements to propose solutions with our platform/product, communicate the integration process in an easy-to-understand manner directly with our new partners, and oversee the live launch and hand-off to Account Management or Customer Success

  • Be a technical voice of the customer; work closely with the product and engineering teams on product loop feedback to help internal teams strategize, iterate, and prioritize new features and updates

  • Triage and resolve bugs and other technical issues throughout the customer journey

  • Continuously create mapping of manual or automated requirements, tests, dependencies, integration playbooks, and technical documents

We’ll be excited if you have

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science or other technical field

  • 3+ years of solution engineering experience or technical consultant manager especially in a customer-facing role for SaaS high-growth companies

  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese are required

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with various technical and non-technical audiences; must have strong empathy and emotional intelligence with diverse customers

  • Advanced technical discovery, documentation, and troubleshooting skills. Detail-minded and data driven.

  • Proven ability with managing and leading multiple technical and high-value enterprise-level integration projects working with various stakeholders on a deadline-driven schedule

  • Start-up, team-oriented mentality

Technical qualifications

  • Experience developing rich applications with JavaScript (ES6), HTML5, and CSS3 is required.

  • Mobile experience (Android, IOS) and cross platform (Flutter, React) is a plus

  • Knowledge of Wordpress, Shopify is a plus

Location

This role is remote and may require some travel. We are looking for candidates based in India.

Don’t hold back

We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
